snippet.title: WASHINGTON PRIME Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4267870/Washington_Prime/
WISHLIST NOW!

WASHINGTON PRIME IS A CONTEMPORARY SHOOTER taking place end of october 1998, from late evening to early morning, in and around an office building downtown d.c.

Arm yourself with time typical weapons and face off against karate-champs, security guards, police impersonators, mercenaries and so forth.

This game takes inspiration from thrillers like the Fugitive, Clear and Present Danger, Heat and Cop Land but when it comes down to it, the gameplay is probably more like you’re inside Die Hard or Raw Deal.

#gametrailers #boomershooter #fps #fpsgames #retrogaming #gzdoom
